title: Aoyagi Toya — Wielding Our Weapons〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: ASTRO FES - Day 1
Ensemble Square - Studio

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Alright. Now that the script for our show's done, let's start practicing, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Our joint performance is tomorrow. We can't afford to waste a second.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Agreed. I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: I look forward to it as well. Though, I have a feeling we'll mostly be practicing independently.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose so. We'll be playing characters from two rival musical groups, each of us a vocalist known for his charm and elegance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And our roles require us to actually compete on the stage and demonstrate that elegance.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Competing in elegance... I guess that's true.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: While I know I have the upper hand, don't expect me to go easy on you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. I'll be giving it my all to be a worthy challenge.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite having said that... Sena is right.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's an idol and a professional model based in Europe.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Also, I can tell just how much he has refined his singing and movements from watching Knights practice yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If I want to have a fighting chance in a battle of elegance, I'll need to brush up the quality of my performance by a substantial amount.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to do all that I can.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Hey, he can sing pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: However...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Great. I think I have the song down.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: The singing, at least.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Everything else was awful. I couldn't stand watching.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you mind elaborating...?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: First of all, you focused so much on the singing that you neglected your posture. I don't know about street music, but if you're going to perform on a stage, you'd best stand tall and present well. Got it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: U-Understood!

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line:
Now let's talk about your body movement...
Am I right to say you're just moving to the music in whatever way comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... Yes, you might be right.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: That's not good enough. The way you command your body is crucial for demonstrating elegance. Think about how you want to present yourself and move accordingly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for the advice, Sena. I'll try that out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Presenting yourself in the way you want others to see you... Sena definitely fulfills his role through his body movement as well as his singing.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I think I'll try adding some hand gestures to start...)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Stop, stop!

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Nothing's changed. Just moving your hands isn't going to solve the problem. Be aware of what you're doing, all the way to your fingertips.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... Understood!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How is this?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Better than before. But your movement is still awkward and doesn't look very elegant.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Try to match the feeling of the song. Tone down the pace and flow through your movement.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Like this.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Understand? Don't break focus for a...

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line:
What?
What's with the blank face? Are you even listening?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... My apologies. I was just in awe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The movement is the same, and yet, you did it so gracefully. It looked completely different from how I did it. As expected of a professional model.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Is that so? Well, this is my forte, after all.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Also, that's what's required for our roles. As a professional, I wouldn't settle for anything of lesser quality.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Actually, no. This applies to everyone, regardless. Anyone who stands on stage is a performer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right. I would also like to perform my role as well as you, Sena.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Good. That's an excellent attitude to have.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, you're a very kind and helpful person, Sena.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: What? You think I'm kind?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even though I'm supposed to be your rival, you still gave me advice. It was very easy to follow, and I learned a lot.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Hold up. I didn't do it for the compliments, you know?

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: My performance would seem like nothing special if I didn't have a worthy opponent. So this was all for my own benefit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Then, I'll be doing my best to be as good as you.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: R-Right... Good luck.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (Something about him throws me off.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (Although, I can't say that I dislike actually getting compliments and being listened to.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: (As for my juniors... It'd be nice if Kasa and the others could learn from Aoyagi's honesty.)

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Just FYI, I don't bother giving pointers to those without potential.

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Think you can meet my expectations, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...! Yes, I will!

rows.Speaker: Izumi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've gotten our individual parts down, let's practice together. It'd be better to go over the flow of the actual performance, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood. Sounds like a plan.
